originalLicenseNote: Engine source under GPL-3.0-or-later; embeds the default network nn-1a298aa575a0.nnue from https://github.com/official-stockfish/networks, whose networks were uploaded under CC0.
blurb: Stockfish 19 is the September 2026 release of Stockfish, developed through Fishtest distributed SPRT testing. It pairs magic bitboards, singular extensions scaled by their margin, multi-cut and negative extensions, ProbCut, razoring, futility, null-move and SEE pruning, upcoming-repetition detection, and continuation, capture, pawn and low-ply histories with correction histories, all evaluated by a single embedded NNUE with threat, king-relative and pawn-pair inputs. Adapted to UCI over WASI from the pinned sf_19 commit, following its own Emscripten WebAssembly architecture with SIMDe in place of Emscripten's x86 headers.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build on the C poll helper, with the thread pool's jobs run on the UCI thread and Threads fixed to 1; the Makefile's wasm32 architecture (the SSE4.1 path with its WebAssembly intrinsics, sloppy atomics), compiled with SIMDe to 128-bit WebAssembly SIMD, with node counts equal to the native AVX2 build's and to the release's bench; a finished infinite or ponder search waits in the helper for its stop; no Syzygy tablebases; Hash capped at 1024 MB.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: Magic bitboards for slider attacks, with a BMI2 PEXT path natively.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Principal variation search with iterative deepening, MultiPV and aspiration windows.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Depth- and eval-scaled null-move pruning with a verification search at high depth.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Reduced capture search against a raised beta, from depth 3.

features.label: Razoring
features.implementation: Quiescence verification when the eval is far below alpha.

features.label: Futility Pruning
features.implementation: Child-node (reverse) futility pruning and futility pruning of quiet moves.

features.label: Internal Iterative Reductions
features.implementation: One ply less on PV and cut nodes without a hash move.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Singular extensions scaled by how far the hash move stands out, with multi-cut and negative extensions.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Reductions adjusted by history, node type, correction and TT state.

features.label: SEE Pruning
features.implementation: SEE thresholds prune captures and quiet moves, also in quiescence.

features.label: Histories & Correction
features.implementation: Butterfly, continuation, capture, pawn and low-ply histories, plus pawn, minor-piece, non-pawn and continuation correction histories.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Clusters of three entries with generations, bounds and static evals.

features.label: NNUE
features.implementation: Single embedded net: threat, HalfKAv2_hm and pawn-pair inputs, a 1024-wide accumulator, then 32 and 32 in 8 layer stacks with 8 PSQT buckets.
